director.text: Namaste Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher hoon. Aaj cricket pitch jaise number line par fractions dekhenge. Tumhe cricket mein kya pasand hai?
samajh nahi aaya

Aaj hum bhinn ko ek seedhi line par jagah denge. Cricket ki pitch socho. Ek stump 0 par, doosra 1 par. Batsman run lene bhaaga aur theek beech mein ruk gaya. Woh pitch ki ek pakki jagah par khada hai, toh us jagah ka bhi ek number hai.
haan samajh gayi
Yeh rahi 0 se 1 tak ki line. Upar theek beech mein ek mark hai, toh upar line ke 2 barabar gaps ban gaye. Is mark ka naam hai 1/2. Yeh hissa saaf hua?
samajh nahi aaya
1/3 ka neeche wala number 3 dekho: woh batata hai 0 se 1 ko kitne barabar gaps mein kaatna hai. 1/3 bhi ek poore ka ek tukda hai.
thoda hindi mein samjhao

Bilkul, ab yeh Hindi mein bolti hoon. Line ke theek beech mein ek mark hai. Woh line ko do barabar gaps mein baant-ta hai, isliye uska naam 1/2 hai. Zoya ka kehna hai ki 1/3 toh 3 ke paas aata hai. Tumhe kya lagta hai: 1/3 isi 0 se 1 wali line par hai, ya 3 ke paas?

Cricket ki baat bhi hogi, bas yeh number line wala kaam khatam ho jaaye. Wahi 0 se 1 ki line, par ab upar 6 marks hain. Marks mat gino, gaps gino: 7 barabar gaps. Toh 0 ke baad pehla mark hai 1/7. Ab line ke neeche dekho. Wahan 0 aur 1 ke beech 7 marks hain, sab barabar doori par. Neeche line kitne barabar gaps mein bati hai?

director.text: 7 sahi nahi hai. Darzi ka ribbon socho, 0 se 1 metre. Upar 6 chalk ke nishaan hain, aur ribbon ke 7 barabar tukde. Pehla nishaan pehle tukde ke end par hai, isliye uska naam 1/7 metre. Naam tukde ginkar milta hai, nishaan ginkar nahi. Yahan tak theek hai?

Bilkul sahi. Dekho, beech ke marks se gaps hamesha ek zyada, toh 7 marks ke 8 gaps. Ab wahi 0 se 1, par upar 8 barabar gaps hain. 7 gaps se zyada gaps, toh har ek chhota gap hai. Pehla mark 1/8, bilkul 0 se chipka hua. Ab neeche dekho: wahi line 10 barabar gaps mein kati hai. 0 ke zyada paas kaun rukega: 1/8 ya 1/10?

Haan, bilkul theek: 10 gaps wala har gap 8 gaps wale se chhota hai, isliye 1/10 pehle ruk jaata hai, 0 ke paas. Ghar 0 par hai aur school 1 km par. Beech raaste mein 3 bijli ke khambe barabar doori par khade hain. Pehla khamba ghar se kitne km door hai?
mujhe nahi pata
Ghar se school tak 1 km ka raasta hai, aur beech mein 3 khambe barabar doori par hain. Pehla khamba kahan hai, yeh dhoondhna hai. Yeh kadam saaf hai?
haan, samajh aaya
Pehla kadam dekho. Ek line kheencho, ghar 0 par aur school 1 par: 0 se 1 tak ki line, kyunki ghar se school tak ka poora raasta hi humara ek poora hai.
hmm, achha
Ab doosra kadam. Khambe mat gino, unke beech ke gaps gino: 3 khambe, toh 4 barabar hisse, kyunki beech mein jitne marks hon, gaps hamesha usse ek zyada.
ab main jaati hoon, bye
